roomModifiers.name: Elite Guard

roomModifiers.name: Frenzy
roomModifiers.description: Foes move faster but fall easier.

roomModifiers.description: Foes shrug off a third of your damage.

roomModifiers.name: Swarming
roomModifiers.description: Half as many foes again, and they are a little frailer.

roomModifiers.name: Volatile
roomModifiers.description: Foes burst when they die. Keep your distance.

roomModifiers.name: Mending
roomModifiers.description: Wounded foes slowly knit back together.

roomModifiers.name: Darkness
roomModifiers.description: The lights are out in here.

roomModifiers.name: Bounty
roomModifiers.description: A rich reward for clearing this room.

roomModifiers.name: Glass Ranks
roomModifiers.description: Foes hit like a storm but break like glass.
